description: Consumo Combustible, 2015 - 2026 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Superintendencia de Electricidad (SIE). Este conjunto de datos presenta el consumo mensual de combustibles utilizados para la producción de energía eléctrica en la República Dominicana durante el período 2015–2026. Coverage: Superintendencia de Electricidad (SIE). The portal files it under the publisher Superintendencia de Electricidad (SIE). Its tags are Electricidad, Energia, Sociedad y Bienestar. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
